title: Tanzanian Pineapple Ginger Juice
community: Tanzanian juice bars — the most refreshing combination
author: Chef Jabir
desc: Tanzanian Pineapple Ginger Juice — fresh pineapple blended and strained with fresh ginger and lime, served over ice. The juice that hits every note simultaneously — sweet, tart, spicy, and deeply refreshing. One of Tanzania's most popular juice bar combinations.
longDesc: Pineapple and ginger is one of the great flavour partnerships in tropical juice making — the pineapple's sweetness and bromelain depth balanced by the ginger's warming spice. Tanzania produces excellent pineapples in the coastal and highland regions, and this juice makes the most of them.
ingredients: ½ large ripe pineapple — peeled, cored, and cubed
3cm fresh ginger — peeled and roughly chopped
steps: Blend pineapple and ginger with 1 cup cold water until smooth.
Strain through a fine sieve, pressing the pulp firmly.
Add remaining cold water, lime juice, and honey.
chefTips: The ginger heat increases over time — if making ahead, use less ginger than you think.
Press the sieve pulp firmly — the most concentrated juice is in the pulp.
commonMistakes: Too much ginger if making ahead.
cookingScience: Pineapple contains bromelain — a proteolytic enzyme that gives fresh pineapple juice a distinctive slightly astringent quality and helps break down proteins. Combined with gingerols from the ginger, the drink has a powerful dual anti-inflammatory effect.
sustainabilityTips: Tanzanian coastal and highland pineapples — locally grown.
culturalNote: Pineapple ginger juice is the juice bar staple of Tanzania's urban health-conscious community — the combination that orders itself, that every vendor has, and that never disappoints.
